groups.defect: In update and destroy, EmbeddableHost.where(id:).first can return nil. A stale or unknown id then raises NoMethodError (a 500) instead of returning a 404.

answer.reasoning: Both suggestions report the same defect in the same place: the same controller, nearly the same lines (9-17 and 9-18), and the same two actions. In each case, update passes a nil host to save_host and destroy calls nil.destroy. Both propose the same fix: use find, or raise NotFound. Both judges agree they are duplicates. The only disagreement is needsUnifiedComment. Each suggestion already covers both actions, and neither adds a defect the other lacks. Either one could replace the pair without losing anything, so needsUnifiedComment is false.
